paite: TOUPA Pathian tapate ahong kilak ni uh a-om nawn a, huan TOUPA ma a kilak ding in alak uah Setan leng ahong pai hi.
heading: Setan In Job Aze-et Nawn
english: Again, on the day when God’s sons came to present themselves before Yahweh, Satan came also among them to present himself before Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA'N Setan kiang ah, "Koi a hong kipan na hia?" achi hi. Setan in TOUPA adawng a, "Leitung langkhat langkhat tawn a, asung a sukvak-touvak ka hi," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Satan, “Where have you come from?” Satan answered Yahweh, and said, “From going back and forth on the earth, and from walking up and down in it.”

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Setan kiang ah, "Ka sikha Job na ngaihtuah ngei hia? Amah bang a hoihkim leh mitang, Pathian kihta a hoih lou mudah lei ah lah kuamah a-om ngal kei a; ama siatna ding in hon tangsak mah lechin, aginomna alen tinten hi," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Satan, “Have you considered my servant Job? For there is no one like him on the earth, a blameless and an upright man, one who fears God, and turns away from evil. He still maintains his integrity, although you incited me against him, to ruin him without cause.”

paite: Setan in TOUPA adawng a, "Vun sik in vun, ahi, mihing in aneih tengteng hinna sik in ape ding hi.
english: Satan answered Yahweh, and said, “Skin for skin. Yes, all that a man has he will give for his life.

paite: Himahleh tu in na khut kha inla, aguh leh asa khoih lechin, na maitang ah nang hon gense ding hi," achi hi.
english: But stretch out your hand now, and touch his bone and his flesh, and he will renounce you to your face.”

paite: TOUPA'N Setan kiang ah, "Ngai in, amah na khut ah a-om hi; ahinna lel hawi in," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Satan, “Behold, he is in your hand. Only spare his life.”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA ma a kipan in Setan apawtkhia a, meimatum in akhepek nuai a kipan aluzang tan in Job agawt hi.
english: So Satan went out from the presence of Yahweh, and struck Job with painful sores from the sole of his foot to his head.

paite: Huchi in ama'n kikhuatna ding in belpei ala a; meivu lak ah atu hi.
english: He took for himself a potsherd to scrape himself with, and he sat among the ashes.

paite: Huai lai in azi in akiang ah, "Na ginomna len tinten lailai na hi hia? Pathian gensia inla, si in," achi hi.
english: Then his wife said to him, “Do you still maintain your integrity? Renounce God, and die.”

paite: Himahleh akiang ah, "Numei hai thugente lak a khat bang in thu na gen a. Bang ahia? Pathian khut ah hoih i mu dia, hoih lou leng i mu kei dia hia?" achi hi. Hiai tengteng ah Job in amuk in thil ahihkhial kei hi.
english: But he said to her, “You speak as one of the foolish women would speak. What? Shall we receive good at the hand of God, and shall we not receive evil?” In all this Job didn’t sin with his lips.

paite: Huchi a Job lawm thumte'n atung a hiai hoih lou hong tung tengteng azak un, michih ama mun a kipan in ahong ua: Teman mi Eliphaz, Shuah mi Bildad leh Naaman mi Zophar, amah kah ding leh amah lungmuan ding in hohkhawm ding in hun seh abawl uhi.
heading: Job Lawmte'n Hong Veh Uh
english: Now when Job’s three friends heard of all this evil that had come on him, they each came from his own place: Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite; and they made an appointment together to come to sympathize with him and to comfort him.

paite: Huchi a gamlapi a pan adaktouh uleh, amah athei kei ua, nakpi in akikoukhia ua, akapta uhi. Apuanaktual uh michih in abotkek ua, alutang uah van lam ah leivui akibuak uhi.
english: When they lifted up their eyes from a distance, and didn’t recognize him, they raised their voices, and wept; and they each tore his robe, and sprinkled dust on their heads toward the sky.

paite: Huchi in akiang ah leitual ah ni sagih leh zan sagih atu ua, akiang ah kuamah in thu khat leng agen kei uh; alungkhamna anasa mahmah chih amu uhi.
english: So they sat down with him on the ground seven days and seven nights, and no one spoke a word to him, for they saw that his grief was very great.
